name: Drink Roulette
description: Native offline PS5 party drinking game for 2 to 8 players with an animated bottle roulette wheel, controller-friendly neon interface and 433 unique challenges. Includes Standard, Wild, Couples, Quickfire and Truth & Dare modes, configurable challenge packs, editable player names and persistent settings. Designed for pass-and-play with a single controller.
author: YAHBALLON
